depiction.primary_object: outlined heraldic shield with pointed top and bottom
modifiers: diagonal slash from top-left to bottom-right
depiction.composition: single object, front view, crossed out by a diagonal bar

readings.meaning: disable security / protection off / turn off firewall or antivirus
cancel insurance policy or warranty coverage
turn off ad blocker or content filter

ambiguity: At very small sizes, the crossed-out shield can resemble a crossed-out location pin or a slashed water drop.

modifier_semantics.meaning: disabled, turned off, cancelled, unprotected, or removed

task_intents: turn off ad blocker for site
opt out of extended warranty protection

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a shield with a diagonal slash through it, universally read as disabling protection/security, vulnerability, or cancelling insurance/warranty coverage. It fits a concrete niche of tech tasks (turning off firewalls, ad blockers, or fixing vulnerabilities) and financial/admin tasks (cancelling insurance policies, PMI, or extended warranties). It must be distinguished from an intact shield (enabling security or buying insurance) and from a slashed location pin at small sizes.
